title: Blank flash (fully erased)

setup.describe: Erase the ENTIRE flash (foreground — a backgrounded espflash has died silently mid-write before)

manual: Open the printed Studio URL (capture streaming is armed).
Click Connect and pick this board's port in Chrome's chooser.
Wait for the card to settle — it should read as blank flash / needs firmware.
Return here and press Enter to finish the capture.
